denominator_unit: business-day namings with the next day answered
definition: Of the business names returned on a day (raw strings), the share also returned on the next day; pooled over cells.

denominator_unit: business-day namings with the next day answered
definition: The same share after the name gate and alias merge (v1 P).

denominator_unit: business-day namings with a row for the next day (a next day with no names counts as not recurring)
definition: The W2-3 form of raw P: the next day only needs to have been asked, so an empty next day counts against persistence.

denominator_unit: business-day namings with a row for the next day (a next day with no names counts as not recurring)
definition: The same next-day-asked form on gated names.

denominator_unit: consecutive day pairs on which both days named at least one business
definition: Mean overlap (Jaccard) of the raw name lists on two consecutive days, pairs where both days named someone.

denominator_unit: consecutive day pairs on which both days named at least one business
consecutive day pairs on which both days named at least one business
definition: Mean overlap of the gated name lists, pairs where both days named someone.

denominator_unit: consecutive day pairs on which both days named at least one business
consecutive answered day pairs with at least one gated name on either day
definition: Mean of 1 minus overlap over consecutive answered days where either day has a gated name (v1 C; a pair with one empty day counts as full churn).

denominator_unit: cells with at least one gated name
definition: Mean over cells of the concentration index H, the sum of squared shares of named days (v1 H).

denominator_unit: cells with at least one gated name
definition: Mean over cells of 1/H, the number of equally common names the cell behaves like (v1).
Share of answered days on which at least one name survived the gate (v1 N).
Share of asked days (a row exists) on which the engine returned at least one business name.

denominator_unit: business-cell pairs named on at least one answered day
definition: Share of businesses named on 20 to 80 percent of answered days, so one day's answer is close to a coin flip (v1 S).

denominator_unit: days on which both engines answered and at least one named someone
definition: Mean overlap of two engines' raw name lists on the same day.

denominator_unit: days on which both engines answered and at least one gated name exists
definition: Mean overlap of two engines' gated name lists on the same day (v1 A).
